comment: Public ed25519 keys that sign distribution artifacts (runtime, CLI, map packs). Each key is bound to one channel and the hosts that serve it: the CLI accepts a download only when its signature verifies under a key bound to the host it came from, and the publish tool refuses a preview or public artifact whose signature does not verify. Message format and key handling: docs/cloud-api.md, Distribution signing. Private keys live only in SSM /simforge-release/<channel>/distribution-signing-key.
